verdict.rationale: Featurebase mentions AI helping 'declutter & find the most impactful opportunities' and exposes a Reports API for analytics, suggesting some feedback-theme and impact insight capability, but there's no evidence of a conversational AI assistant that can be asked natural-language questions about feedback themes tied to revenue impact. Missing for 10: evidence of a chat/Q&A AI interface over feedback data, explicit revenue-impact metrics or linkage, and any hands-on example of querying themes and revenue together.
